individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart shows median state frequencies aggregated across bins of Pol II ChIP-seq signal for n=5912 promoters per bin; this is a continuous binned trend representation (analogous to a line plot) where overlaying thousands of individual promoter data points would be unreadable, so individual points are not required.

The single-molecule stack already displays every individual DNA molecule (one row per molecule, 2952 molecules) with its own methylation pattern; the adjacent sidebar summarising state frequency is a direct visual summary of the fully-shown individual data, so no separate overlay of points is needed.

Same representation as panel A (stacked bar/area chart of median state frequencies across bins for n=6122 mouse promoters); a continuous binned trend plot where individual point overlay is impractical.
Same representation as panel B; every individual molecule (2871 molecules) is already shown as a row in the single-molecule stack, so the underlying individual data are fully displayed.
